CommunityApplications.Profile:
**Glance Editor**: your [Glance](https://github.com/glanceapp/glance) dashboard and a no-code editor for it, in one container.
Build pages, columns and widgets, pick a theme, icons and a background, add community widgets, and preview everything before it goes live, all in the browser and without writing YAML. Glance itself is included, at the version the editor is tested with.
Glance is the work of the glanceapp/glance project and its contributors; this repository only adds the editor around it.
Support and questions: [GitHub issues](https://github.com/{{REPO}}/issues). Source, screenshots and install guide: [github.com/{{REPO}}](https://github.com/{{REPO}}).
